{{Draft}}
Every field of the [[Artists]] forms, in the order of the form. Field names are given as they appear in the forms; where a field appears under another name in some forms, that name is given in brackets. Fields filled in automatically (who created or changed an entry, and when) are not listed.

'''Input:''' ''text'', ''number'', ''tick box'', ''list'' (choose from a fixed list) or a link to another record. '''Required''' fields must be filled in before saving. Long lists are shown on the [[Field reference/Base tables|Base tables]] page.

== Main form ==
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%"
! style="width:18%" | Field !! Meaning !! style="width:14%" | Input !! style="width:28%" | Values
|-
| '''Last name''' || The artist's surname as used in the catalogue. || text || 
|-
| '''First name''' || The artist's first name or names as used in the catalogue. || text || 
|-
| '''Alias''' || Short name of the artist shown in lists and dropdowns. Choose it once and keep it. Other names of the artist go into the alternative names. || text || 
|-
| '''Gender''' || The artist's gender. || list<br />'''required''' || female, male, other, trans to female, trans to male, hermaphrodite, undecided, not known, not applicable
|-
| '''Nationality''' || The artist's nationality. || list || 265 entries, see [[Field reference/Base tables#Countries|Countries]]
|-
| '''Address Line1''' || First line of the artist's postal address. Published only if Is Address Public is ticked. || text || 
|-
| '''Address Line2''' || Second line of the postal address. || text || 
|-
| '''Address Street''' || Street and number. || text || 
|-
| '''Address City''' || City of the postal address. || text || 
|-
| '''Address ZIP''' || Postal code. || text || 
|-
| '''Address State''' || State, province or region. || text || 
|-
| '''Address Country ID''' || Country of the postal address. || list || 265 entries, see [[Field reference/Base tables#Countries|Countries]]
|-
| '''Born in City''' || Place of birth. || text || 
|-
| '''Bonr in country''' || Country of birth. || list || 265 entries, see [[Field reference/Base tables#Countries|Countries]]
|-
| '''Day of birthdate''' || Day of birth, if known. || number || 
|-
| '''Month of birthdate''' || Month of birth, if known. || list || January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December
|-
| '''Year of birthdate''' || Year of birth. || number || 
|-
| '''Qualifier birth date''' || How certain the date of birth is, for example approximate or before. || list || approximate, exact, estimate, minimum, unknown, earliest, after, before, at latest, unverified, unlimited, in part
|-
| '''Died in city''' || Place of death. Leave empty for a living artist. || text || 
|-
| '''Died in country''' || Country of death. || list || 265 entries, see [[Field reference/Base tables#Countries|Countries]]
|-
| '''Day of deathdate''' || Day of death, if known. || number || 
|-
| '''Month of deathdate''' || Month of death, if known. || list || January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December
|-
| '''Year of deathdate''' || Year of death. || number || 
|-
| '''OPENCR_DiedDateQualifier''' || How certain the date of death is, for example approximate or after. || list || approximate, exact, estimate, minimum, unknown, earliest, after, before, at latest, unverified, unlimited, in part
|-
| '''Default language''' || The main language of the artist's catalogue. || list || German, English, French, Italian, Spanish
|-
| '''CR web publicationstates''' || Workflow code for publishing scripts. Leave it at its default unless your project has agreed on values. || number || 
|-
| '''CROffline Publication State ID''' || Workflow code for the printed catalogue. Leave it at its default unless your project has agreed on values. || number || 
|-
| '''Is Address Public''' || Tick to publish the postal address. Independent of Public, so a published artist can keep the address private. || tick box || 
|-
| '''Images directory'''<br /><small>(not in the forms)</small> || The folder for the artist's image files, set up when the artist is created. Never renamed. || text || 
|-
| '''Is member of Collecting Society''' || Tick if the artist's rights are managed by a collecting society, such as VG Bild-Kunst or SIAE. || tick box || 
|-
| '''Collecting Society''' || The collecting society, as a directory entry. || link to a directory entry || 
|-
| '''Public''' || Tick to publish the artist. As long as it is unticked, only editors see the artist. || tick box || 
|}
